item: Drawn copper read as imported copper (exact fill, flow-based faces) in the FVM and FDM
why: A drawn layer with a cell cut by a zone edge takes the exact cell fill and the faces of the imported copper; only these four boards have such a layer, and only at 2 mm (their other copper edges lie on cell lines) Its records and times also moved by fix/face-film-half-slab are held in face-film-half-slab.json (key also_moved_by), so that each record is in one file.
